setting.title: Settings

setting.footerAnalyticsPlaceholder: Paste Baidu/Google Analytics JS code, injected into storefront page bottom
setting.distributionEnabledTip: When enabled, logged-in orders pay commission up the referral chain based on gross profit (also requires .env ZCARD_DISTRIBUTION=true master switch)

setting.supplySupplierEnabledTip: When enabled, this site exposes a supply API for others to dock and source from you (incl. self-docking)
setting.supplyNonceStoreTip: Replay-prevention nonce storage backend for supply API. Cache uses cache store (default); Redis requires REDIS_* config; Database uses a DB table
setting.supplyRateLimitTip: Max requests per account per minute for the supply API; exceeds returns 429
setting.supplyTimestampSkewTip: Supply API requests whose timestamp differs from server time beyond this value are rejected (replay prevention). Recommended 300 (5 min)
setting.siteKeywordsPlaceholder: e.g. virtual goods, auto delivery, card keys
setting.siteKeywordsTip: Comma separated, used for search engines and sharing
setting.brandSloganPlaceholder: e.g. Leading virtual goods auto-delivery platform · 24/7 instant dispatch

setting.serviceScriptPlaceholder: Paste the complete <script> install code provided by Chatwoot / Crisp
setting.serviceScriptTip: ⚠️ DANGER: this script runs same-origin on every visitor page and can read login sessions. Only paste code from fully trusted providers. Supports complete Chatwoot/Crisp install snippets or plain JavaScript; external SDK URLs must use HTTPS and their domains must be in the allowlist below
setting.serviceAllowedHostsTip: Comma separated. External script/SDK domains referenced in the snippet must be in this list, otherwise the code is dropped (anti-injection). Empty uses defaults: official Chatwoot / Crisp domains
setting.siteFaviconTip: Browser tab icon; falls back to the site logo when empty

setting.adminAlertEmailTip: Requires mail (SMTP) to be enabled; leave empty to disable the email channel
setting.adminAlertChannelTip: A channel is enabled when its config is non-empty. TG: create a bot via @BotFather. WeCom: add a group robot and copy its webhook
